mission: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas PC

frontier_before.supervisor_instruction: Materialize the first readable WP03 strict diagnostic before grammar or typed-IR mutation.

hypothesis: The red strict self-contained WP03 run is caused by a V7 LALR grammar ambiguity, not by typed-IR semantics.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The red run is transport/receipt plumbing or a typed-IR regression; V7 strict grammar itself is clean.

primary_result.first_observed_error: Shift/Reduce conflict for terminal IFF. [strict-mode] * <dotted_relation : qid DOT_REL>

causal_localization.mechanism: dotted_relation has optional RHS: dotted_relation: qid DOT_REL [primary]. After qid DOT_REL, tokens that can begin primary can compete with reduction/follow paths, creating strict LALR shift/reduce conflicts.
causal_localization.example_ambiguity: After a dotted relation prefix, keyword-like tokens such as iff/requires/or/subset_of can be interpreted as a relation RHS identifier or as expression continuation/operator depending on parser state.
causal_localization.decision: Do not patch typed IR or WP04 from the red run. Repair/evaluate only the V7 typed-surface grammar boundary first.

v17_relation_membrane_on_v7_typed_fn_can.change: Remove optional dotted_relation and use the V17-style lookahead-bounded DOTTED_PREFIX_REL branch while retaining V7 typed-fn/operator identity surface.
required_next_evidence: full frozen G9 + Dialect strict parse and semantic-hash differential
hyphenated identifier versus compact subtraction policy discriminator
registered Andreas Ubuntu target receipt before formal gate promotion

out_of_box_experiment.name: REVERSIBLE_CONFLICT_PEELING_LESION
out_of_box_experiment.method: Repeatedly remove only the currently reported keyword operator alternative while preserving its identifier role, rebuild strict V7, and observe the next hidden conflict. No repository grammar was modified.
out_of_box_experiment.result: The failure is a family of optional-RHS/follow conflicts, not one isolated IFF token collision. Keyword-priority patching alone is therefore structurally insufficient.

supported_points: Lark strict=True raises on shift/reduce and regex collisions for LALR.
Regex collision checking in strict mode requires interegular.
Advanced regex/lookaround can limit regex-collision detection, so lookahead candidates require explicit metamorphic boundary tests in addition to strict construction.

architecture_delta.change: Reclassify WP03 remote red result from UNKNOWN to V7_STRICT_CONTRACT_BLOCKED_GRAMMAR_AMBIGUITY. Do not attribute it to typed IR. Keep V17 selected for WP02. Evaluate a typed-fn surface that inherits the already-supported V17 dotted relation membrane rather than making dotted RHS mandatory or applying keyword-only precedence fixes.
architecture_delta.rollback: No production grammar change was committed in this run; rollback is receipt removal only.

next_frontier: Materialize an exact-byte interegular-enabled WP03 grammar diagnostic receipt using the current V7 source to independently confirm the strict conflict family on Ubuntu.
Build the smallest V7-typed-fn/V17-relation-boundary research candidate and run full frozen G9+Dialect + typed-IR semantic-hash differential without promotion.
